sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AKS-74N is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. I won't keep you tied up with a long explanation. I've got an order for an AKS-74N with Zenitco parts. It needs ergonomics at or above 52, combined recoil below 275, and must take up no more than 10 slots. The most important part is that it has to include a B-30 handguard, B-33 dust cover, DTK-1 muzzle brake, RK-0 vert grip, RK-3 pistol grip, PT-3 stock, new-gen AK-12 magazine, a Klesch-2IKS device, and any other Zenit parts you can find. I assume it's meant as a gift for some former Saint Petersburg resident."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AKS-74N to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"So, is that Saint-P AK ready? Leave it in that crate. Thanks."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AKS-74N specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 275 or less recoil
- 52 or more ergonomics
- 10 or fewer cells
- AK Zenit B-30 handguard with B-31S upper handguard rail
- Zenit RK-0 tactical foregrip
- AK-12 5.45x39 30-round magazine
- Zenit Klesch-2IKS IR illuminator with laser
- AK Zenit DTK-1 7.62x39/5.45x39 muzzle brake
- AK Zenit RK-3 pistol grip (Black)
- AKS-74/AKS-74U Zenit PT Lock + AK Zenit PT-3 "Klassika" stock
- AK Zenit B-33 dust cover

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AKS-74N from Prapor LL2.
- Make sure to use the correct AK-12 5.45x39 30-round magazine, not the AK-12 5.45x39 early model 30-round magazine.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
